confidence_flags: This is a STRUCTURAL roof framing plan (light-gauge steel C/2C truss members with grid1-5 spans, x-total 14.00 matching the gridline master) — recorded as pattern 'plan' per the roof_plan-vs-plan rule, not skipped as architectural roof_plan.

Member callouts (ตะเข้สัน, อกไก่, จันทัน, etc.) are leader-line labels naming a member TYPE that recurs across the whole truss (hip rafters, ridge, common rafters at regular spacing), not individually marked/numbered instances with their own grid_ref like the RC beams on other sheets — recorded as one representative steel_section entry per named member type with grid_ref left null, rather than inventing per-instance positions the drawing does not give.
warnings: CORRECTED 2026-08-24 โ€” span_length_m was ABSENT on every beam in this file (the key was missing entirely, not null). It has been computed from the grid master for every beam whose grid_ref_start and grid_ref_end are both exact, using the straight distance between the two grid intersections (Pythagoras where the beam is diagonal, so chamfered members get a real length too). This is pure computation from the grid per the ยง4 rule that span is calculated by code and never estimated by the model โ€” no position or mark was changed. Beams whose refs still carry a ~ are left without a span, because an approximate endpoint cannot yield an exact length.

RB1/RB2 are a different thing from the steel truss members: they are RC ring beams at the top of the walls (wall-plate level) that carry the steel roof frame, matching the rebar sections given for RB1/RB2 on หน้า26 (SECTION RB1/RB2). Recorded here as beam elements at their approximate plan position (posts/support points shown on this sheet); full spec (width/height/main_bar/stirrup) lives on the หน้า26 section file and joins by element_id.

'แปกัลวาไนซ์' (galvanized purlins) is printed without an explicit size callout on this sheet (unlike the other members, which all print a WFC/2C size string) — recorded with steel_section omitted and a note, rather than guessing a size.
Fascia/barge board members (เชิงชาย, ทับเชิงชาย, ปั้นลม, ทับปั้นลม) are hardwood trim, not structural steel — recorded as element_type 'accessory' with material 'wood', not steel_section.
